title: Tidewatch Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning home offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience, located just moments from the newly opened WaterColor Beach Club and the popular lazy river at Camp WaterColor. With easy access to the Marina Pool, Tennis, Boathouse, and a variety of nearby shops and restaurants, guests will have no shortage of activities to enjoy. The home's beautifully upgraded kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, is ideal for preparing everything from quick beach snacks to delicious home-cooked meals. The open-concept living area and screened porch provide ample space for everyone to unwind after a fun-filled day.
